do_not_change.summary: Preserve exact historical retries after a project domain change.
do_not_change.evidence: Existing-key replay compares the immutable fact hash and complete stored graph without revalidating the historical URL set against the project's current domain.
do_not_change.impact: Historical immutable facts remain retriable while new events remain constrained by the active domain.
do_not_change.recommendation: Retain this replay path when evolving URL or domain handling.

do_not_change.summary: Preserve Action links as associations outside the immutable Event fact.
do_not_change.evidence: Complete graph validation compares the Event core and URL set, intentionally excluding current actionIds.
do_not_change.impact: Action/run cascades and later append-only links cannot make a valid immutable Event appear corrupt.
do_not_change.recommendation: Do not add Action-link coordinates to the Event fact hash or replay-equality check.
